REFLEXO-Portable Bluetooth Speaker| Eco Friendly

Features

Made of Eco-Friendly Materials: Say goodbye to excessive plastic waste with our eco-friendly speaker. Constructed with 100% bio based eco friendly material, this speaker reduces plastic usage without compromising on performance.
Go Eco with Biodegradable Components: Our commitment to sustainability extends to every aspect of the REFLEXO-Portable Bluetooth Speaker. The housing is crafted with 100% bio based eco friendly material, while the fabric grill is made of pure biodegradable jute, ensuring a greener footprint.
Built-in EQ for Customized Sound: Tailor your listening experience to suit your preferences with the built-in EQ settings. From Pop to Jazz, Classical, and Rock, easily switch between EQ modes to enjoy optimized sound for every genre.
Rich Sound Quality: Enjoy crystal-clear audio with the REFLEXO-Portable Bluetooth Speaker 10W super sound and built-in bass radiator. Whether you’re streaming music or watching movies, experience immersive sound that brings your entertainment to life.

Sustainable Materials

At the heart of eco-friendly portable speakers lies a commitment to sustainable materials. Manufacturers are increasingly opting for recycled or renewable resources in the construction of speaker components. From bamboo and cork to recycled plastics and aluminium, these materials offer a blend of durability, aesthetics, and eco-friendliness.
